purpose: Provide one compact cross-family matrix for the current small-LLM control-surface genome: every atlas row joined to its prompt/output/source/internal/frontier/reliability/transfer/gate cells.

validation_checks.why: The family matrix must cover every atlas row exactly once.

validation_checks.predicate: matrix column count matches declared columns
validation_checks.why: Downstream work should depend on a stable cross-family column set.

validation_checks.predicate: matrix primary blockers == mixture law primary blockers
validation_checks.why: The matrix must be a derived table, not a new blocker taxonomy.

validation_checks.predicate: matrix frontier counts == decision frontier counts
validation_checks.why: Lead-time cells must match the canonical decision-frontier layer.

validation_checks.predicate: matrix reliability counts == reliability matrix counts
validation_checks.why: Reliability cells must match the canonical reliability matrix.

validation_checks.predicate: matrix transfer counts == transfer matrix counts
validation_checks.why: Transfer cells must match the canonical transfer matrix.

validation_checks.predicate: matrix terminal stages == gate geometry terminal stages
validation_checks.why: Gate-stage cells must match the canonical gate-geometry layer.

validation_checks.predicate: selected matrix boolean axes == mixture pressure counts
validation_checks.why: Boolean cross-family cells are direct pressure-class memberships.
The matrix must preserve MC005 as the only bounded internal-causal reference.
The matrix must preserve the current lead-time monitor-only frontier.
The cross-family table must not imply a promoted/full/transfer-ready mechanism.
A cross-family row without claim boundaries or evidence is not audit-ready.
